title: Design specification
description: How the change is built, per acceptance criterion. Testing is in the test plan, written separately.

criteria.description: Exactly one entry per acceptance criterion id.

id.description: Acceptance criterion id as given, e.g. AC1.

changes.description: What changes in backend, API and UI. If this departs from a solution proposed in the ticket, say why.

queries.description: Every new or changed database query. Empty if none.

name.description: Function or query name in code.

sql.description: The SQL shape as issued, parameters as placeholders.

index.description: The index used at production size, and why the planner picks it. Never empty.

observability.description: Logs, metrics, traces, alerts and dashboards this change adds or changes, so it can be diagnosed in production. Empty only if the change emits nothing new.

name.description: Event, metric, span, alert or dashboard name as it will appear.

purpose.description: What question it answers when something goes wrong.

fields.description: Fields or tags it carries, e.g. trace id, tenant, record id.

blocking.description: True if the answer changes scope. Blocking questions stop the run until the user answers.

changes: New endpoint get-order-history returning saved versions newest first

queries.name: order-versions
queries.sql: current row UNION ALL (history WHERE id = ? ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 501)
queries.index: history primary key (id, version), read backwards, stops at 501 rows

observability.name: orders.history/failed
observability.purpose: find why a history page failed for one order
